packages/checkpoint/src/state.ts.message: Date.parse normalizes impossible ISO dates (e.g. 2026-02-30) instead of rejecting them. A malformed lastForcedAt can therefore be accepted and create a settle bypass.

packages/checkpoint/src/stop-gate.ts.message: stop_hook_active is global to all Stop hooks. Another hook's block can preserve this gate's chain and trigger an early ceiling force-release without N checkpoint re-blocks.
